author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Framed stage with two curtains draped from the top centre out to the sides, and the audience as a row of heads seen from behind along the bottom, as in the reference; the current drawing's two ring heads and frowning shoulder arcs under an arch read as a face.
omissions: The reference's inner stage arch is left out (no room between the curtains at 8-unit spacing); the audience is shown as three head-backs rather than full busts, since three busts cannot fit the width at 8 spacing and read as a face.
